question: Name the Indo-Persian Dance form from Uttar Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It is known for its intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures, often telling stories from ancient Indian epics.
 
• Kathak has its roots in both Hindu and Muslim cultures, showcasing a blend of Indo-Persian traditions.
 
• It is one of the eight major classical dance forms recognized in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Garba** is a folk dance from Gujarat, not Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Chhau** is a semi-classical dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins from Eastern India.
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance form from Kerala, known for its elaborate costumes and makeup.
 
• Kathak dance performances often include a mix of storytelling, rhythmic foot movements, and facial expressions.
